name: emergency-map
description: A monorepo template with DDD + Hexagonal Architecture, auth, deployment configs, and a Todo CRUD example

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && oxfmt --check . && pnpm run build --filter='@emergency-map/*' && pnpm run check-types && pnpm run test
scripts.db:push: dotenvx run -f apps/server-hono/.env -- turbo run db:push -F @emergency-map/infra-db
scripts.db:studio: dotenvx run -f apps/server-hono/.env -- turbo run db:studio -F @emergency-map/infra-db
scripts.db:generate: dotenvx run -f apps/server-hono/.env -- turbo run db:generate -F @emergency-map/infra-db
scripts.db:migrate: dotenvx run -f apps/server-hono/.env -- turbo run db:migrate -F @emergency-map/infra-db
scripts.db:seed: dotenvx run -f apps/server-hono/.env -- pnpm --filter @emergency-map/infra-db run db:seed
